functionDeclarations.description: Order a flower arrangement from the hotel florist for delivery to a room or recipient. The catalog (arrangements, prices, delivery cutoff) is in lookup_policy topic "florist" - look it up first and let the caller pick the arrangement, never pick for them. Collect the delivery date, where it goes (room number or recipient name), and the gift-card message, and read the card message back so it's right. Once they pick and agree, THIS CALL places the order - saying "I'll get that arranged" orders nothing; nothing exists until this returns a reference.
functionDeclarations.name: order_flowers

on_date.description: Delivery date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.
on_date.title: On Date

deliver_to.description: Where it goes - the number of the room or the recipient's name. Prefer room number when available.
deliver_to.title: Deliver To

card_message.description: The gift-card message exactly as the caller dictates it.
card_message.title: Card Message

guest_phone.description: The caller's phone number, in case the florist needs to reach them.
guest_phone.title: Guest Phone
